_meta.note: Costs are in tainted. 9 tainted = 1 blemished. 81 tainted = 1 pure.

services.name: Simple Origin
services.description: 2–3 powers, no resource bars or complex conditions.

services.name: Medium Origin
services.description: 4–6 powers, may include resource bars, cooldowns, or layered conditions.

services.name: Complex Origin
services.description: 7+ powers, custom resource bars, chained conditions, Apoli/Apugli tricks.

services.name: Minor Origin Tweak
services.description: Value changes, cooldown adjustments, small condition edits on an existing origin.

services.name: Power Swap / Rework
services.description: Replacing or significantly altering 1–2 powers on an existing origin.

services.name: Major Origin Overhaul
services.description: Rebuilding most of an existing origin while keeping its theme.

services.name: Figura Accessory / Overlay
services.description: Hats, tails, wings, horns — small add-ons over the default player model.

services.name: Full Custom Figura Model
services.description: Complete player model replacement. Price scales with detail and part count.

services.name: Model + Lua Scripting
services.description: Custom behaviors, emotes, action wheel integrations. Quote required first.

services.name: Cosmetic Item Retexture
services.description: Custom texture on an existing item. No new mechanics.

services.name: Functional Custom Item
services.description: Custom recipe, NBT behavior, or stat modification via datapack + resource pack.

services.name: Complex Item Set
services.description: Multiple interconnected items, loot tables, advancement triggers, etc.

services.name: Character Starter Bundle
services.description: Simple origin + Figura accessory overlay. Great for a new character.

services.name: Full Character Bundle
services.description: Medium origin + full custom Figura model. The complete experience.

services.name: Premium Character Bundle
services.description: Complex origin + full model + custom item. Everything, all at once.

services.name: Mod Commission
services.description: Custom mod work. Requires detailed brief. Can take weeks to months.
